title: ファンタジーワールド ～魔王の想いと真実と～
description:
🎮 [About This Game]Create your own anime hero from billions of possible combinations and take them on a classic turn-based JRPG adventure. Explore hand-designed puzzle dungeons, discover hidden secrets, and uncover the truth behind the Demon Lord.

Long-sealed evil stirs again.

A new generation of heroes sets out to uncover the secrets left behind by those who came before.

 

 
 

📖 [Story]Long ago, the heroes who stood against the world's greatest threat could only seal away the Dark Demon Lord. 
 
 
 But the truth behind that battle was never revealed. 
 
 
As darkness rises once more, a new generation of heroes begins their journey. 
The deeper you venture, the closer you come to a secret that changes everything you thought you knew. 
 
 

Discover the key features that shape your adventure.

 

👧 [Character Customization]Create your ideal adventurer with billions of possible combinations.
 
 
Female characters alone can combine 125 front hairstyles and 126 back hairstyles, creating 15,750 unique hairstyle combinations. 
 
 
Customize 17 different appearance options, including hairstyles, eyes, outfits, and much more to create a character that's truly your own. 
 
 
You can redesign your character at any time during your adventure.

 

🧩 [Puzzle Dungeons]No two Puzzle Dungeons play the same. Push blocks into place, spot anomalies inspired by The Exit 8, or navigate exploration-heavy layouts where one wrong turn changes everything.

Solve:

・Block-pushing puzzles

・Observation-based anomaly puzzles inspired by The Exit 8

・Exploration-focused dungeon challenges

Each dungeon introduces a new twist, rewarding players who look closely and think carefully.

🎲 [Random Dungeons]Explore 7 unique Random Dungeon types, all hand-designed with care—no algorithm, just deliberate level craft hiding surprises around every corner.

No two adventures are exactly the same.

What you'll find inside:

・Random events with multiple outcomes

・Hidden rewards and rare discoveries

・Companion-exclusive events

・Permanent stat upgrades earned through exploration

 

🎮 [More Features]⚔️ Classic turn-based RPG combat

🎨 Billions of character customization combinations

🧩 Puzzle Dungeons with unique mechanics

🎲 7 types of Random Dungeons full of surprises

🐉 Summon powerful allies early in your adventure

🎁 Rare enemies, hidden bosses, and secret events

🌸 Seasonal maps that change over time

🏯 Enemies inspired by Japanese mythology and folklore

🌾 Farming, quests, casino minigames, and more 
 

🎻 [Carefully Selected Soundtrack]Every scene is matched with music carefully selected to fit its atmosphere.
 
 
For some moments, more than 1,000 pieces of music were compared before the final track was chosen. 
 
 
The soundtrack is designed to capture the nostalgic feeling of classic JRPGs while giving every area its own unique identity. 
 

Public-domain classical pieces are also used in select scenes, chosen to resonate with the story and characters.

 
 A Sound Test feature lets you replay unlocked tracks whenever you like.

[About AI-Generated Images]A very limited number of AI-generated images are used.

They are only used for background images on the title screen and menu screens.
description_short: A retro-inspired 2D JRPG featuring deep character customization, classic turn-based combat, puzzle dungeons, and hand-designed random dungeons.
